messages:
Carla: quick q — PR #9876 is docs-only (OpenAPI examples). Do we treat this as a patch or minor?
Ben: docs-only = patch historically, but we've been inconsistent.
Dave: agreed, patch if no behavioral change. But openapi schema changes could be minor. this is purely examples.
Alice: +1 patch. also: do we want the deploy-bot to auto-bump docs-only? saves manual steps.
Eva: caution — auto-bump for docs could pollute changelog with noise. we should have a filter. :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: I scanned PR #9876: files changed: docs/openapi/examples/*.yaml. Suggested action: tag bump=patch, release-note=none. run `deploy-bot bump --auto`?
Ben: what about using buildmeta to indicate docs-only so it's searchable, e.g. `v1.12.3+docs`? keeps semver clean while surfacing reasons.
Carla: I like `+docs` for internal tracing. but consumers might ignore buildmeta. we still need correct semver core.
Dave: Could we standardize: docs-only -> patch semver; if deploy-bot sees only `docs/` or `api/specs/examples` then it appends `+docs` metadata when tagging.
Alice: agree. Also flag for changelog generator to collapse docs-only entries unless `--verbose` is passed.
Eva: Any rollback implications? If a docs change causes downstream SDK generation to break, we might need fast rollback. But that's rare.
Ben: rollout policy: docs-only releases go to staging and wait 1 hour for SDK CI; if SDK fails, auto-rollback. That avoids surprises.
Carla: can we express the tagging command? e.g.:
```
git tag -a v1.12.3 -m "patch: docs only" && git tag v1.12.3+docs
git push origin refs/tags/v1.12.3 refs/tags/v1.12.3+docs
```
Dave: +1, but note git doesn't like `+` in refs on all platforms. maybe use `v1.12.3+docs` only in metadata store (release notes DB) not as Git tag. keep git tag simple.
release-bot: storing metadata for v1.12.3 -> {"meta":"docs","pr":9876} (simulated)
Ben: ok good point. store `+docs` in release metadata, not tag name. keep semver tag strictly `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`.
Carla: decision then: docs-only = patch bump; deploy-bot auto-suggests patch; deploy-team approved to auto-apply patch tag on merge but NOT push `+meta` tags to git, instead write metadata to release service. changelog generator hides docs-only by default. rollout: staged release with 1h SDK validation window; auto-rollback on SDK failure.
Alice: I'll update the deploy-bot config snippet. proposed config: 
```
# deploy-bot config snippet
rules:
  - if: changed_paths =~ "^docs/|^api/specs/"
    change_type: docs-only
    bump: patch
    metadata: docs
    auto_apply_on_merge: true
    rollout: staging
    sdk_validation_window_minutes: 60
    auto_rollback_on_sdk_fail: true
```
Eva: sounds good. please include an escape hatch: `no-auto` label to skip auto-bump for special cases.
Carla: yep add `no-auto-bump` label.
Ben: who owns updating the public release notes policy? I can draft language to say we collapse docs-only entries by default.
Carla: assign to Ben. Ben: can you add the label and PR to deploy-bot by EOD?
Ben: will do.
Carla: thanks — marking this thread resolved for ops planning. :white_check_mark:
